interactions.title: Discovery call
interactions.summary: IT Director Sarah liked native SSO and security, but procurement said the $100k quote exceeds their $85k Q3 budget.
interactions.raw: Discovery call with Acme Corp. Evaluated our Enterprise tier. IT Director Sarah loved our native SSO and security features. However, procurement flagged that our $100k proposed quote is 18% over their allocated Q3 budget ceiling ($85,000).

interactions.title: Follow-up meeting with CFO
interactions.summary: Met with CFO Marcus Webb who noted Apex Systems is 20% cheaper but lacks SOC2 compliance and native SSO, prefers written briefings and a phased rollout across two quarters.
interactions.raw: Follow-up meeting with CFO Marcus Webb (economic buyer). Acme is currently evaluating Apex Systems as a lower-cost alternative. Apex quoted 20% cheaper, but Marcus acknowledged Apex lacks SOC2 compliance and native SSO. Marcus prefers short written briefings over live demos and requested a phased rollout option to split costs across two quarters.
interactions.next_action: Prepare written brief and phased rollout proposal
